Increased Range is an Engineering Blueprint for Frame Shift Drives that increases optimized mass, generally improving maximum jump range at the cost of higher module mass and power draw plus lower integrity.

{{#invoke:EngineeringBlueprints|infobox|fsd_increased_range}}

== What It Does ==
Increased Range is the main range-focused Frame Shift Drive Blueprint. Optimized mass affects how efficiently the drive moves the ship; increasing it generally improves jump range.
